definitions.explanation: The quality of being tied to a particular season. Common as a noun modifier (used with の) for things that appear or recur seasonally, especially in medical and business contexts.

examples.japanese: {季節性|きせつせい}⟦インフルエンザ→インフルエンザ：05384_infuruenza⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{流行|りゅうこう}→流行：03678_ryuukou⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{季節性|きせつせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{季節性|きせつせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考慮|こうりょ}して→考慮する：06061_kouryosuru⟧⟦{在庫|ざいこ}→在庫：04701_zaiko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調整|ちょうせい}する→調整する：10442_chouseisuru⟧。
examples.english: We adjust inventory taking into account the seasonality of sales.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧ (season) + ⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧ (nature, property — abstract noun suffix). Used both as an attributive noun ({季節性|きせつせい}⟦インフルエンザ→インフルエンザ：05384_infuruenza⟧ = seasonal flu) and predicatively to describe how strongly something varies with the seasons.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {季節性|きせつせい}⟦インフルエンザ→インフルエンザ：05384_infuruenza⟧: seasonal flu
- {季節性|きせつせい}⟦アレルギー→アレルギー：04645_arerugii⟧: seasonal allergy
- {季節性|きせつせい}⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧: seasonal product
- {季節性|きせつせい}⟦{需要|じゅよう}→需要：02616_juyou⟧: seasonal demand
- {季節性|きせつせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧／⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧: highly／weakly seasonal

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧: season — the noun itself
- ⟦{旬|しゅん}→旬：12716_shun⟧: peak season (for food) — narrower, about the best time to eat something
